rule: Include only Earth sites where NASA/JPL ran rover, mobility, EVA or mission-operations field tests, each with a citable NASA/JPL/peer-reviewed URL for the activity AND numeric coordinates from a stated source. Artificial yards excluded. Window: 1.92 km COP30 (OpenTopography globaldem), reprojected bilinear to site-centred aeqd 30 m (src/gate3_common.earth_patch); >= 95% valid else skipped with reason.

dumont_dunes.coord_source: GNIS-derived TopoQuest record (NAD83), as used in Gates 1-2
dumont_dunes.activity: MSL team mobility tests with the Scarecrow test rover, May 2012

moses_lake_sand_dunes.coord_source: LOW QUALITY: recreation listings (The Dyrt 47.0632,-119.3204; Overlandbound 47.0630,-119.3168), rounded mean; not an official gazetteer
moses_lake_sand_dunes.activity: NASA lunar robotics/spacesuit field tests (incl. JPL ATHLETE, ARC K10), June 2008

haughton_crater.coord_source: published crater centre 75 23 N, 89 40 W (Wikipedia; Arctic journal 1978 gives centre 75 22 N)
haughton_crater.activity: NASA Ames K10 robotic survey field test, 10 Jul - 3 Aug 2007

excluded.black_point_lava_flow_AZ: Desert RATS activity cited (NASA Earth Observatory, NTRS 20100036344) but no numeric coordinates found from a citable source within the time box
excluded.cinder_lakes_crater_field_AZ: Apollo training cited (USGS/NPS), but no numeric coordinates found; the field is also largely an artificial (blasted) crater field
excluded.meteor_crater_AZ: coordinates available (35.0275,-111.0222) but a NASA/JPL/peer-reviewed citation for the field test was not verified within the time box (only secondary press found)
excluded.mauna_kea_pisces: 2010 ILSO-ISRU test at Pu'u Hiwahine cited (J. Aerospace Eng., ASCE), but no numeric coordinates for the test site found

coverage_definitions.if_branch_PASS_FULL_NO_SUPPORT_or_INCONC: current method = fingerprint A, 19 frozen 30 m features, Gate 3 pooled mean/std (unchanged), T = 2.317; a Moon patch is covered by a set if its z-distance to the nearest site in the set < T
coverage_definitions.if_branch_BASELINE_ONLY: current method = slope method: a site provides a 30 m slope bin ([0,5),[5,10),[10,15),[15,20),[20,30),[30,90]) if >= 5% of its valid 30 m area is in it; a Moon patch is covered if >= 95% of its valid 30 m area lies in bins provided by >= 1 site of the set

sets.b: USGS-29 (Gate 3 known sites with COP30) union NASA test sites

coverage_definitions.denominator: 145 Moon patches (results/moon_patches.json); patch fractions are not area fractions of the lunar south pole
coverage_definitions.nature: current (method per G3v branch); historical Gate 3 60.0% kept separate
